limitations: The exact projection norm is obtained only for spoke lengths between 1/2 and (1+sqrt(17))/4, inclusive; the strict inequality versus the continued formula is established from that boundary up to 3/2.
The invariant is the minimum operator norm of projections onto the cycle subspace of a weighted edge l1 space, not the projection constant of the quotient transportation-cost space.
The established unweighted wheel value is a special case, not a standalone novelty claim.
Absence of an equivalent result in unindexed literature cannot be guaranteed.
title: Sharp radial-weight plateau and radical boundary for wheel cycle projections
